cohort: 6198 neonates admitted to the inborn and out-born neonatal care unit at Al-Ramadi Teaching Hospital for Maternity and Children between January 1st and December 31st 2020
finding: The incidence of pneumothorax in newborns was 0.8%.
mod_finding: The proportion of pneumothorax was significantly higher among neonates whose mothers delivered through Cesarean section compared to vaginal delivery.
